text: Always check the license before opening a TBC command (command_ui_open/run_command do this via Server.TheServer.CanUseFeature(cmd.LicenseCodes)). Unlicensed commands open a license popup whose buttons lead into the License Manager; never press them - close with X (tbc_dialogs action=dismiss).
In TBC grids (DataGridView), checkbox cells only reach the model through a real mouse click; programmatic cell values change only the display. ui_grid action=set does the click automatically.
Posted window messages from the MCP server process do not reach TBC's controls (likely Windows UIPI). Deliver clicks in-process through the control's WndProc instead (ui_grid click does this).
Layer Manager is a dock pane (scope 'pane:Layer Manager'), toggled with run_command layermanager. The red X is the 'Delete' column; deleting an empty layer gives no confirmation popup.
Panes like Layer Manager stay open after use; close them when done (run_command layermanager toggles it). The user asked for TBC to be left tidy.
TBC Rotate Objects: a positive angle rotates clockwise.
Change Elevation on a linestring stores the new elevation as a vertical element (vertex z becomes undefined); read it with get_entity (effective z) or Linestring.UpdateSnapElevation.
Drape Objects On Surface creates a new DrapedLine on the panel's Layer field; the source line is unchanged.
Disable Redundant BS (key DisableRedundantBacksights) acts immediately on ALL redundant backsights in the project. Never run it to explore; only when the user asks.
Loop Closure (key LoopClosure) runs immediately and opens the GNSS Loop Closure report in the web browser. Clear the selection first.
Processing Services (key ExternalProcessingServices) opens a Trimble web page in the user's browser. Do not open it unless asked.
Some TBC popups are WPF windows (e.g. 'Feature Library Missing' from Convert CSV to FXL). The dialog tools now detect them via PresentationSource; earlier versions missed them and left them open.
Before opening an unfamiliar command, read its help (tbc_help action=read command=<key>); the help says whether it acts immediately.
Run the MCP server and helper scripts with Python 3.12 (py -3.12). CPython 3.15 crashed (Fatal Python error _TAIL_CALL_CACHE) inside html.parser.

Compute Project progress window (title Compute Project, message Computing the project, only a Cancel button) appears after edits like Transform Survey Points. Earlier test code kept going and its cleanup could press Cancel on it; a TBC error report popup (buttons << and OK) followed and was closed unread. Now: wait_idle before every command action, never dismiss progress windows, log error popups to knowledge/memory/tbc_errors.log and stop.
Average Points: Point ID box takes the NEW point ID as text; select the reference points first, press Add, then Compute.

Deleting a layer: select it (set_selection with the layer serial) and run TBC's Delete command (delete_entities does this). Layer Manager's red X stopped responding to automated clicks when the pane was too narrow for the Delete column (horizontal scroll); prefer the Delete command.
Move Survey Point: Point ID = the point's serial (picker), To = a point ID typed as text; OK adds an office-entered coordinate and renames the point to '<id>(MOVED)'.

Integrate to Geometry (geometrypointintegratecmd): select a CLOSED linestring polygon (selection is taken at open), set Starting point ID (use the next free number), press Process. New points go to the default Points layer (no layer option), numbered clockwise, skipping IDs that already exist. The panel reports e.g. '4 points were added'.

Transform Survey Points: select points, tick Delta Easting (eastingCheckBox) and enter deltaEasting (ids: labels in this panel are unreliable), Apply. TBC then recomputes the project (Compute Project window) - wait for it.
Rename Points: Add constant radio + parameterBox value, untick chkReport to skip the report, OK. 4700483 + 1000 -> 4701483.

Single Proportioning: Planar (grid), Select starting/ending position = point IDs typed as text, Layer, Starting point ID (next free), then record distances in distanceEdit, distanceEdit#2, ... (a new row appears after each one is filled; tick fixedCheckBox to hold a distance). Apply. Test: 100.06 ft measured, record 50+50 -> new point at 50.03 ft.

Double Proportioning: four input groups (North/East/South/West) share the same box names; select the direction radio, then fill coordinateEdit (known point ID), bearingEdit (record azimuth from the known point toward the missing marker, e.g. 180 from North) and distanceEdit, for each direction. The fill tool targets the visible group. Apply creates the point. Test: known points 50.05 ft out on each side, record 50 each -> point exactly on the marker.

Panels with alternative input groups reuse control names; when several fields share an id or label, fill the VISIBLE one. Re-read the panel after option/dropdown changes because they can rebuild inputs.

Create Points at Station Offsets: Name (collection), Start point / End point = point IDs (WPF boxes; they parse when focus leaves, the fill tool tabs out), then the point row: ClientAreaTextBox#9 = station, ClientAreaTextBox#10 = offset (+ = right of the baseline), text = point ID (next free). OK creates the point on the default Points layer plus a StationOffsetFactory collection named after Name (delete both when cleaning up). Missing baseline gives 'The transformation could not be calculated with the input data.'

PRIVACY: tbc_view screenshot copies screen pixels, so when another application covers TBC it captures that application instead (happened once, 2026-10-13; the image was discarded). The tool now refuses unless every sampled point of the view belongs to TBC's own window.

Create COGO: Options tab -> Collection name, COGO layer, Points layer, auto lines/points, Starting point (next free) -> Create (collection is created). COGO tab: 'Line commands' box takes alpha codes (SP <pt>, LB <az> <dist>...); after each Enter the box pre-fills the previous code. Automated typing (pasted text, WM_CHAR keystrokes, the 'Enter (New Line)' button) did not produce linework - UNRESOLVED; try the interface buttons (Start/Line drop-downs) next time.

Legal Description Writer needs picks IN THE PLAN VIEW: 'To select a starting point, click on the end of a line segment'; paths/parcels are picked by clicking segments. The panel pickers reject SetEntity for a plain point. Not automatable with the current tools (no Plan View picking); works on COGO parcels, polygons or closed linework; output TXT/RTF.
New Feature Library: Library name -> OK creates an (empty) feature library in the project. Afterwards Write FXL to CSV is enabled and Convert CSV to FXL stops showing 'Feature Library Missing'.

Write FXL to CSV: dialog 'Write FXL to CSV' -> Target file (BrowseFile box; type the full path) + Include column headers -> OK writes a CSV with header rows for point, line and polygon definitions (tbc_dialogs action=fill index=0).

Convert CSV to FXL: dialog with Source file (UltraTextEditor + '...' Browse button; typing the path does not load it, the file must be chosen through Browse), Original File grid -> select rows -> Add to Points/Lines/Polygons/Blocks/Control Codes -> per-tab 'Add to Feature Library'. The automated Browse click did not open the file dialog - UNRESOLVED.

Process Feature Codes: panel lists point sources (imported files / keyed-in blocks) in PointSourceGrid (UltraGrid). Tick a source by setting its Include cell (works here, unlike Merge Points), press 'Process Source(s)' (UltraButton), then TBC asks 'Do you want to view the feature code processing report?' - answer No to avoid the browser. Codes need definitions in the project's Feature Library to produce linework.

Survey spreadsheet views (Feature: NewFeatureSpreadsheetCmd, Occupation: OccupationView, Vector: VectorView, Optical: OpticalView) and Time-Based View open as separate windows (not panels). Each holds a DisposingUltraGrid; read rows via c.Rows / DisplayLayout.Bands[0].Columns, then close the window (command_ui close_forms) - user preference. Vector cols: ['Vector ID', 'From Point ID', 'To Point ID', 'Solution Type', 'Status', 'GNSS Vertical Offset', 'PDOP', 'H. Precision (DRMS)', 'V. Precision (DRMS)', 'Satellites']; Optical cols: ['Observation ID', 'Status', '1st Backsight ID', 'From Point ID', 'To Point ID', 'H. Angle', 'V. Angle', 'Azimuth', 'H. Distance', 'V. Distance']

Adjust Traverse: Traverse name list -> '<Create New Traverse>' -> type traverseNameTextBox -> Create. Pick the start station in stationComboBox and press addButton (icon-only): TBC then follows the observations and adds the rest of the traverse itself (201(S1) -> 205(S5) -> 201(S3) on the test project). Settings: Mode, Adjust horizontal (Compass/Bowditch/Transit), vertical, angles. 'Preview Results' tab shows misclosures/precision; Apply stores the traverse adjustment (a Traverse object named after the traverse; deleting it removes the adjustment).

Total Station Editor: opens 'Select Total Station Files' (ListView of imported files incl. 'Keyed-In Total Station File'); select a file item, OK -> 'Total Station Editor - <file>' dialog (WinForms) with OK/Cancel. Opened and cancelled on an imported .jxl job file; editing its contents not automated yet.

Adjust Network (AdjustProjectTerraNet) on the test project: TBC warns 'There are still 29 unresolved project computation errors... Do you want to continue?'. Continuing (first attempt) ran ~63 s then TBC raised 'Attempted to read or write protected memory ... Undo changes until you are able to compute the project'. Answer No and resolve the project computation errors first (Flags pane). Panel: Subnetwork list, Constraints/Weighting tabs, Adjust button, 'Status: No adjustment done'.

Local Site Settings: Coordinate type, Northing/Easting (project location), Elevation (project height, m_tbHeight1), ground origin, Use ground coordinates, Ground scale factor (+compute), false easting/northing. OK applies and TBC recomputes the project (~68 s on the test project); verified by reopening (20 -> 25 -> restored 20).

Geoid Sub-Gridding / Datum Gridding: panel lists .ggf (geoid) / datum grid files from a folder (default C:\ProgramData\Trimble\GeoData); 'Create Sub-Grid' is disabled until a file is listed, then you draw a window on a globe in the Create Geoid Grid File dialog and Save. Drawing on the globe is not automatable; Upload sends to a field device (don't).

Explode Points: Find Explodable Points with nothing selected lists every multi-observation point (test project: 4339, e.g. 102 with 8 observations). Select the row in pointList (DataGridView) and press Explode: 102 became 8 points named 102_X (+7 total); TBC recomputes (~63 s). Undo (run_command undo) restores it. Merged office-entered points are NOT explodable (only one coordinate is kept).

CAD tab Explode (key explode) only works on blocks (BlockReference); CAD polylines and linestrings give 'No explodable objects are selected.' (Survey > Explode Points is a different command: see explodepointcmd.)

Merge Points WORKS when the extra point's Included cell is ticked through the grid's own edit path: ui_grid action=set grid=ugMergeDuplicateCandidates row={...} column=Included value=true (EnterEditMode -> ToggleCheckbox -> ExitEditMode); then OK. Verified by hand: 2 duplicates -> 1 point.

Picker fields: strings are typed as text (a point ID like 4700486 is not an object serial); only an explicit integer serial / {serial: n} links an object, and it must exist. Average Points' Point ID box takes the new ID as text.

Three-Point Circle/Rectangle point boxes are WinForms CoordinateEdits: a point ID set in code shows but TBC says 'Pick a point in a Plan View or Sheet View.' and creates nothing. command_ui_fill now types real keystrokes + Enter, which works (verified: circle through A,B,M has r=50).

Create Boundary, Polygon mode with typed point IDs keeps only Point + the LAST Additional point (vertices need view picks). Verified route: make a closed line (e.g. Create Rectangle) and use 'Polygon (from a line)' = True with m_ctrlExistingEntity = that line's serial, press OK -> Data.Construction.Boundary with the line's corners.

Capture Outline needs picks in the Plan View: typed coordinates replace each other on tab-out, and Enter in the Coordinate box means OK/finish (popup 'Enter at least two coordinates.', which blocks the call until dismissed). Not automatable without view picking; ask the user to pick.

Fillet/Chamfer identifies segments by the pick location in the view. Linking the line by serial leaves PickPoint empty: Apply does nothing (Apply to entire line) or TBC asks 'radius too large ... changed to the maximum allowed 0.000 ft. Do you accept?' (answer No). Needs the user to pick the segments.

Offset: 'Side to offset' is a LeftRightEdit; command_ui_fill sets its Side enum from 'Left'/'Right' (typed text alone stayed Right). Left/Right are relative to the line direction (eastward line, Left = north). Verified: 10 ft left -> new linestring at +10 N.

Trim/Extend: 'One line to bounding lines' needs a view pick (which end). Use 'Multiple lines to bounding lines': memBoundariesMulti = [bounding serials], MultipleMemberSelection = [lines to change], MultipleBoundingExtendRadioButton or ...TrimRadioButton = true, Apply. Verified: line 0..50 extended to x=100.
Set Line Elevation refuses lines with 3D vertices: 'Linestrings with 3D coordinates cannot be given a constant elevation.' It is for 2D lines (no vertex z).
Delete Segment: Line = serial; the list shows segments like '1 - Straight - Point ID'; select an item (fill list = item text) and press Delete. Verified: deleting segment 1 of A-B-C leaves B-C.

Create Linestring / Polygon / Breakline: OK opens the Edit Linestring pane. LocationTypeComboBox = 'Point ID', then per vertex fill 'Point ID' and click Save as a SEPARATE call (press=Save in the same fill lost vertices). Close finishes; a line with < 2 vertices is discarded.

Multi-select boxes ('Selected: N', MemberSelection) can be filled with a list of serials, e.g. ["memBoundariesMulti", [123, 456]]; needed when a panel has two of them or ignores the preselection (Trim/Extend, Clip, Track Region, Composite Geometry). A WPF box value ending in a newline presses Enter once (Quick Line adds a vertex per Enter); don't use it where Enter means OK.

WPF object pickers (Trimble.Vce.UI.Controls.Wpf.SelectEntity, e.g. Divide Area 'Area to Divide', Insert Segment 'Line') take an integer serial in command_ui_fill (SetEntity). Strings are typed as text.

Divide Area (dividearea): link the area FIRST - fill 'Area to Divide' with the polygon's serial (WPF picker; it ignores the preselection) and check it shows 'Polygon : <name>'; then Divide area based on, Amount, Origin = pt ID, End point = pt ID (the baseline), press Divide. command_ui_fill refuses Origin/End point while the area is empty (unsafe order, see crash_log 16:04). Verified: 100x50 polygon, baseline A-B, 2 subareas -> two 100x25 polygons parallel to the baseline.

Line Type Editor (LineTypeEditor) and Symbol Editor (SymbolEditor) start a separate program, PEDITOR.exe, with its own window ('Line Type Editor' / 'Symbol Editor'); command_ui tools do not see it. Close it when finished (window X / Process.CloseMainWindow), never kill it.

Opening Dimension Style Manager (DimensionStyleManager) and cancelling marks the project as modified (TBC adds default dimension style data). Harmless, but tell the user the project shows unsaved changes.

Create Text: Layer, Height (display units), Justification, TextInsertionPointCoordinateEdit = pt ID, richTextBox1 = the text; Apply. Creates ForeignCad.MText (TextString). Verified: 'MCP TEST TEXT', height 2 ft.

Edit Text: select exactly ONE text object first (otherwise 'Select one text object.'), open edittext; the Create Text panel appears filled in; change richTextBox1 and Apply. The same MText object is updated (serial kept). Verified.

Linear Dimension: 'Two points' = true, Point1CoordinateEdit / Point2CoordinateEdit = pt IDs (both are labelled 'Dimension style' on screen: use the ids), LocationPointCoordinateEdit = pt ID where the dimension line goes, Layer; Apply. Creates ForeignCad.LinearDimension plus an MText for its text. Verified.

Angular Dimension needs picks in the Plan View: Arc segment and Two line segments both reply 'A valid segment cannot be obtained from the selected object.' when the arc/lines are linked by serial (even single-segment lines). Ask the user to pick.

Label Points: fill 'Selection' (Multi-select points to label) with a list of point serials, Layer, press Add. Panel reports 'Number of points labeled: N'; creates ForeignCad.PointLabelEntity per point on the chosen layer. Verified (2 points).
Label Lines: multi-select box = [line serials], Layer, Add. One ForeignCad.LineLabelEntity per segment ('Number of lines labeled: 2' for a 2-segment line). Verified.

Purge Blocks DANGER: listView1 (checkboxes, 700+ entries on a big project) ticks EVERY unreferenced block definition; Apply purges them all. To purge only some: untick everything, tick only the target names (ListViewItem.Checked), verify the ticked set, Apply, reopen and confirm the list shrank by exactly that many (undo otherwise). Verified: 743 -> 742.

A polygon gets a NEW serial once its vertices are saved in Edit Linestring: the serial shown in the 'Line' box right after OK is replaced (linestrings keep theirs). Look the polygon up by name after Close.

Print Plan View: Create (not Print) makes a plotbox setup named after Name: DynaviewBoundaryCollection + Boundary + PlanGridSheetSet (+ BasicSheet, DynaViews); deleting the first three removes all. Location must be set: it is sometimes pre-filled from the view and sometimes '?', and a point ID there worked 1 time in 3 - type 'northing, easting'. Never press Print unless the user asks.

Import Blocks: browseFile1 = folder; the file appears under 'My Block Files' in treeView1; tick its node (Checked = True) and Import. Creates one BlockView per block plus a file-level block named after the file. TBC remembers the folder path (a user setting): restore it afterwards.

Line/Polygon Label Table: label the lines/polygons first. OK opens the Edit Label Table pane; fill memberSelection with the serials and press Add ('Number of segments: N'). The table (LineLabelTable / PolygonLabelTable) is NOT listed on a layer - find it by type and Title to clean up.

Scale Bar: 'Specify scale' + nedScale, cboBarType (Scale Line / Alternating / Double Alternating), cboLayer, cdeLocation typed 'northing, easting'; OK. Creates Alignment.ScaleBar, which is NOT listed on a layer.

Create 3D PDF: default output is the project folder; set m_OutputFile to an agreed path and ModifyProjectSettings = false. Leave the contact boxes (name, phone, email, company, website) empty unless the user provides them. ~11 MB for the test project.
Insert Image did not create anything from typed input (BrowseFile path accepted and validated, Lower corner typed, Scale, Apply): it is placed/sized with grips in the view. Ask the user to place it.

Dropdowns whose items are .NET objects (Scale Bar type, Sheet set type, Leader type) used to show type names; command_ui now reads the on-screen caption (ComboBox.GetItemText), so fill them with the visible text.

Export (key export): the pane has format category tabs in GroupTab (GIS, Construction, CAD, Custom, Points, Survey, Point Cloud, Mobile Mapping, Corridor); pick the tab (UltraTabStrip SelectedTab), then FormatList = exporter name. The panel REBUILDS per exporter: find the data box by its 'Selected: N' value (m_SelectedEntities / _memberSelection) and fill it with serials; TargetFileBox = FULL path (default is the project folder); press Export. Never use Remote Save (Connected Workspace, online). Verified: Custom 'P,N,E,elev,Code' -> exact CSV rows; CAD 'DXF exporter' -> POLYLINE/POINT entities; Construction 'LandXML exporter' -> all point IDs.

Import (key import) is a WPF pane driven by ImportCommand.ViewModel (TopCommand field 'a'): set vm.RequestedPath = folder (scans the folder; wait for ImporterScanningInProgress False), select files with the grid adapter (ImportCommand field DataGridViewAdapter).SetSelection([FileListItemViewModel...]) -> vm.FilesToImport, then press Import. Each item shows the importer TBC picked (CalculatedImporterText) - CHECK IT: a P,N,E CSV was detected as 'P,E,N,elev,Code' (northing/easting would swap).

CSV import with a custom format opens the 'Import Format Editor - <format>' wizard (Back/Next/Finish/Import/Cancel) while an 'Importing File' progress window waits: press the wizard's Import to import with that format; Cancel aborts the import. Points land on the default Points layer. TBC then recomputes the project (~2 min here).

DXF import: AutoCAD importer; creates the DXF's layers, CAD objects (e.g. Poly3D), a CadImportDataBlock, FileProperties and ImportSelection. A minimal hand-written DXF (no TABLES section) gave 'Error: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.' - use real DXF files (e.g. one TBC exported).

Import COPIES each imported file into the project folder (e.g. <project>\MCP_IMPORT_POINTS.csv); the user chose to keep such copies - tell them the file names. To undo an import, delete the imported DATA (points/objects) only. Do NOT delete the import's FileProperties record (named after the file) with the Delete command: that left a broken imported-file entry and the NEXT import failed inside TBC ('Object reference not set to an instance of an object', then 'unexpected error'; error report: ImportCommandViewModel.UpdateFiles NullReferenceException while RawDataContainer recalculated). delete_entities refuses FileProperties records.

DXF import works (verified 2026-10-14: a DXF TBC exported itself, imported right after a CSV import -> AutoCAD importer, linework as ForeignCad.Poly3D on its DXF layer). The two earlier DXF failures were caused by the test having deleted the previous import's FileProperties record, not by the DXF files.

Select Similar: after setting the source object, only the attributes that apply to it are enabled (a point: Feature code, Feature locked, Layer; the rest are disabled). Untick All properties, tick only the wanted ones, OK. Verified: feature code of a SELA point -> both SELA points.

Advanced select (quickselect): choose m_cbObjectType (e.g. Point), m_rbDataWithTheFollowing, then m_cbProperties (e.g. Feature Code); the operator list (m_cbOperator) and value box appear afterwards: '= Equals', '<> Not equals', regex variants; the value box is ValueCombo (dropdown) for Feature Code, This_value (text) for others. Verified: Feature Code = SELB -> exactly that point.

Select by Layer: LayerCheckedListBox is a checkbox list - ticking a layer selects its objects immediately; Close when done. The fill tool ticks items (highlighting alone selects nothing). Verified: exactly the layer's 6 objects.

Select All / Invert Selection select the whole project (16k objects on the test project). Clear the selection right after (set_selection serials=[]); avoid two whole-project selections back to back (Invert then Select All went down once - see crash_log 2026-10-14 10:31; each alone is fine).
